ModMetaData.name: Colony Organizer (Bill Organizer)
ModMetaData.author: Felipe
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces the workbench "Add bill" list with a window that groups recipes, shows their stats and the stock of materials, so you stop clicking item by item.
- Groups: weapons (melee, ranged, grenades), ammunition (by caliber with Combat Extended), apparel (head, torso, legs, hands, feet, accessories), plus meals, drugs, medicine and the rest by item category. - Sortable columns (damage, DPS, range, armor), bars relative to the best of the bench, minimum filters, search, favorites and recent recipes. - Detail panel: ingredients with what the map has, armor with every material, ammunition picker, and a compare table for up to 3 recipes. - "Can make": how many batches the stored resources allow (x12 on the list, bottleneck ingredient in the detail, "Max" button for the quantity, sortable column). - Pinned resources: Ctrl+click a resource in the list on the left; a panel beside it shows the stock, a minimum alert and the recipes that use it. - A "Recipes" button on every workbench opens the same catalog, so it also works with Nice Bill Tab. - Small benches keep the vanilla menu (threshold in the mod settings). Shift keeps the window open after adding. - Bill queue as cards (drag, pause, copy, change material), copy a whole queue to another bench, queue templates, linked benches and bench priority. - Bonuses and effects of items (mechanitor bandwidth, abilities, shields, implants, drugs) in the detail, compare and search (+bandwidth). - Work task force: a "Task force" button on the Work tab puts many colonists on a work type (e.g. Handling at 1) for a few hours, then gives each one back the priority they had. - Auto slaughter: a "Babies" column keeps babies (about 20% of the meat) out of slaughter and out of the limits.
Works with Combat Extended (armor in mm RHA, ammunition and magazine from the ammo set). Nice Bill Tab replaces the whole bill tab: while its tab replacement is on, open this window with the workbench button. Dubs Mint Menus only adds a side panel and works together with it.
Requires Harmony.
